_note: v2.4 plan 06 seed A sampler overlay, LIVE (real model; so-scenario run <file> --sandbox --group <id>). Run it TWICE on a Text Completion main profile AND twice on a Chat Completion main profile (the first eval records which one ran as `api`; a run on any other API fails). cp-overlay carries an inline preset {temperature 0.37, top_p 0.83}. A recorder registered AFTER the runtime reads the request the overlay left: GENERATE_AFTER_DATA for Text Completion, CHAT_COMPLETION_SETTINGS_READY for Chat Completion. The loud request on cp-overlay must carry 0.37 (and 0.83 where the request carries top_p); the selected preset name and the saved settings file must read back unchanged after the turn; a real memory read taken while the overlay is armed must NOT carry 0.37 (Connection Manager fires neither hook); after /cp activate cp-bare the next loud request is back to the connection's own temperature.

steps.eval: for (const key of Object.keys(globalThis).filter((k) => k.startsWith('storyOrchestratorDebug'))) delete globalThis[key]; const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; rt.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 50 }); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const api = ctx.mainApi === 'textgenerationwebui' ? 'textgen' : ctx.mainApi === 'openai' ? 'chat' : null; if (!api) throw new Error('run this on a Text Completion or Chat Completion main profile, not ' + ctx.mainApi); if (globalThis.__soOverlay?.off) globalThis.__soOverlay.off(); const presetName = () => (api === 'textgen' ? String(ctx.textCompletionSettings?.preset ?? '') : String(ctx.getPresetManager('openai')?.getSelectedPresetName?.() ?? '')); const readFile = async () => { const response = await fetch('/api/settings/get', { method: 'POST', headers: ctx.getRequestHeaders(), body: JSON.stringify({}), cache: 'no-cache' }); const parsed = JSON.parse((await response.json()).settings ?? '{}'); return JSON.stringify(api === 'textgen' ? { preset: parsed.textgenerationwebui_settings?.preset ?? null, temp: parsed.textgenerationwebui_settings?.temp ?? null, top_p: parsed.textgenerationwebui_settings?.top_p ?? null } : { preset: parsed.oai_settings?.preset_settings_openai ?? null, temp: parsed.oai_settings?.temp_openai ?? null, top_p: parsed.oai_settings?.top_p_openai ?? null }); }; const probe = globalThis.__soOverlay = { api, requests: [], presetBefore: presetName(), fileBefore: await readFile(), presetName, readFile }; const eventName = api === 'textgen' ? ctx.eventTypes.GENERATE_AFTER_DATA : ctx.eventTypes.CHAT_COMPLETION_SETTINGS_READY; const listener = (data, dryRun) => { if (dryRun === true || !data) return; probe.requests.push({ active: rt.getEngineState()?.activeCheckpointId ?? null, type: data.type ?? null, temperature: data.temperature, top_p: data.top_p }); }; ctx.eventSource.on(eventName, listener); probe.off = () => ctx.eventSource.removeListener(eventName, listener); return { api, preset: probe.presetBefore, file: probe.fileBefore };

const view = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().samplerOverlay; if (!view || view.name !== 'SO-V2406 Overlay' || view.api !== globalThis.__soOverlay.api) throw new Error('the overlay is not armed for this connection: ' + JSON.stringify(view)); return { armed: view.name, values: view.values };

send_generate.text: I climb the attic stairs slowly, testing each step.

steps.eval: const probe = globalThis.__soOverlay; const loud = probe.requests.filter((r) => r.active === 'cp-overlay' && r.type !== 'quiet' && r.type !== 'impersonate'); if (!loud.length) throw new Error('no loud request was recorded on cp-overlay: ' + JSON.stringify(probe.requests)); const missed = loud.filter((r) => r.temperature !== 0.37 || (r.top_p !== undefined && r.top_p !== 0.83)); if (missed.length) throw new Error('a loud request on cp-overlay does not carry the overlay: ' + JSON.stringify(missed)); const preset = probe.presetName(); if (preset !== probe.presetBefore) throw new Error('the selected preset changed: ' + JSON.stringify({ before: probe.presetBefore, after: preset })); const file = await probe.readFile(); if (file !== probe.fileBefore) throw new Error('the saved settings file changed: ' + JSON.stringify({ before: probe.fileBefore, after: file })); const journal = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSessionJournal(); if (!JSON.stringify(journal).includes('Sampler overlay')) throw new Error('the first overlay apply was not journaled'); return { loud: loud.length, sample: loud[0], preset, file };

const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const original = globalThis.fetch; const bodies = []; globalThis.fetch = async (input, init) => { const url = String(input?.url ?? input); if (url.includes('/api/backends/') && typeof init?.body === 'string') bodies.push(init.body); return original(input, init); }; try { await globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.runExtractionNow(undefined, 'v24-06 overlay memory read'); } finally { globalThis.fetch = original; } if (!bodies.length) throw new Error('the memory read sent no request, so this check measured nothing'); const carried = bodies.filter((body) => { try { return JSON.parse(body).temperature === 0.37; } catch { return false; } }); if (carried.length) throw new Error('a memory-model request carries the checkpoint overlay'); return { memoryRequests: bodies.length, api: ctx.mainApi };

send_generate.text: I go back down and search the study floor.

steps.eval: const probe = globalThis.__soOverlay; probe.off(); if (globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().samplerOverlay) throw new Error('cp-bare has no preset, yet the overlay is still armed'); const after = probe.requests.filter((r) => r.active === 'cp-bare'); if (!after.length) throw new Error('no request was recorded on cp-bare'); if (after.some((r) => r.temperature === 0.37)) throw new Error('a request on cp-bare still carries the overlay: ' + JSON.stringify(after)); return { after: after.length, temperature: after[0].temperature };
